messages:
marta g.: ok bringing up marigold (tiny-embed-6b) on staging for a quick sanity + recall@k smoke. will test int8 and fp16 variants.
kevin: sweet — what benchmarks are we running first?
anil: quick plan: 1) synthetic semsim set (3k pairs) 2) wikipedia kNN recall@1/5/10 3) cluster purity on 50k subsample.
dina: add short-query skew check (<=10 tokens) — seen regressions there before.
marta g.: yep will add. running a baseline fp16 run now (baseline = beryl-embed-v2 fp16). posting logs shortly.
ci-bot: build succeeded: marigold:v0.1-int8 image ready (digest sha256:fa3c...)
kevin: nice. ping me when fp16 baseline numbers are up so I can compare.
(10m later)
marta g.: fp16 baseline complete. recall@1: 0.784, @5: 0.913, @10: 0.934. cluster purity (kmeans k=100): 0.62. short-query recall@1: 0.742.
anil: good baseline. kick off int8 quantized run (per-channel symmetric) with calibration on 1k samples.
marta g.: int8 run started. note: using 8-bit per-channel + clamp (ema stats).
(12m later)
marta g.: int8 results in: recall@1: 0.768, @5: 0.904, @10: 0.925. cluster purity: 0.59. short-query recall@1: 0.701.
dina: delta on recall@1 = -0.016 vs fp16, short-query drop -0.041 — that's larger than usual. any export issues?
kevin: can you paste the eval command + config?
marta g.: sure:
```
python eval/sem_sim.py --model marigold:v0.1-int8 --calib-samples 1000 --batch 256 --metric recall --k 1,5,10 --short-query-filter 10
```
kevin: looks fine. can you run per-layer activation hist stats to see heavy-clamp layers?
anil: also try int8 with per-tensor symmetric (fast path) to see if quant scheme matters.
marta g.: launching per-tensor int8 now. also re-running int8 with 5k calibr samples.
(25m later)
marta g.: per-tensor int8 done: recall@1 0.771 @5 0.907 @10 0.928. clamp-heavy layers: transformer.layer.22.attn_out, transformer.layer.18.ffn_out show high kurtosis.
dina: maybe try bias correction on those layers? small fix we've used before.
anil: agree. also run KNN using cosine vs dot to ensure similarity metric not amplifying quant noise.
marta g.: cosine run queued. trend so far: int8 worse but not catastrophic. I'm logging full diffs to the eval dashboard.
kevin: thumbs up. if short-query drop persists after bias-corr + larger calib, we should mark as regression and hold for tuning.
dina: also want a cluster-level UMAP plot to visually inspect centroid drift.
marta g.: will attach UMAP snapshot and the recall diff table once jobs finish.
ci-bot: eval-job marigold-int8-5k-calib completed (url: https://ci.internal/evals/4450006789)
kevin: thanks. will check the dashboard and follow up in thread. :thumbsup:
